title: Serve
verse: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.
observation: The King of kings gave us a powerful and hard template to follow. He said we should serve others, just like He did. That is hard to do. It's hard to find the boundaries of healthy service. It's hard to serve stupid people. lol. It's hard to not want people to serve us. However, if Jesus did it, we can too.
application: Who can I serve today for God's glory?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us a pattern to follow, then walking with us along the way.
